description: A deterministic 30-case reviewed-memory lifecycle and lexical retrieval benchmark. It covers direct recall, multi-session entities, version updates, Chinese and mixed-language retrieval, erasure, rejected and pending candidates, request-time expiration including the exact expires_at boundary, and adversarial tenant/user isolation through real application lifecycle operations. Opaque aliases are judgments only and never appear in searchable memory fields.
